newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 2.57 million barrels in the week ended Dec 13 to 298.03 million barrels from 300.60 million barrels in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 2.20 million barrels in the week to 298.03 million barrels from 300.60 million.
Distillate stocks rose 1.05 million barrels to 123.22 million from 122.17 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 473,000 barrels to 45.46 million barrels from 45.94 million.
API said gasoline production fell 410,000 barrels in the week to 7.71 million bpd from 8.12 million bpd.
Gasoline stocks fell 3.14 million barrels in the week to 191.46 million barrels from 194.61 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 93.5 percent in the week from 94.2 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 381,000 barrels to 38.07 million barrels from 38.45 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.28 million barrels from 14.38 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 44.19 million barrels from 41.86 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports fell to 7.86 million barrels per day from 8.07 million, API said.
